column1: # The served surface of the dashboard image: every API route, page route and server function
# of the build, and every route of the pinned commit that is not built. Gate 50-routes holds it
# against the build's own outputs. One row per entry, six tab-separated columns:
#   kind     api (a path under /api/), page or function
#   id       the route's full path, or the server function's id (the path /_serverFn/<id>)
#   methods  the methods its server handlers answer, sorted, comma-separated; - for none
#   class    served; opt-in (in the build, refused by the gateway and by the first middleware;
#            only under /api/ai/ and /api/mcp); deleted (its file is in delete.txt)
#   ref      y when a segment of the path is $ref, else n
#   phase    the phase a deleted or opt-in row returns in: P1, P2 or never; - when served
# A deleted route is not in the build and no handler of it runs: its path is answered by the
# request guard, 404 for every method, with or without a trailing slash. A served route asked
# for a method it does not list is answered 405 with Allow, by the guard too; without a valid
# A patch that adds, removes or changes an entry changes its row in the same commit.
